title: Dubai Family Escape
overview: Six days built around what actually works for a family travelling with an eight-year-old — a central Marina base you return to each evening, mornings that start late enough to be civil, and one genuinely unforgettable desert night. Abu Dhabi is a full day out, so we have placed it mid-trip while everyone still has energy.

days.title: Arrival
days.prose: You are met at the airport and driven straight to the hotel in Dubai Marina. The rest of the day is yours — the Marina walk is five minutes from the lobby and is at its best after sunset, when the towers light up and the promenade fills with families.

days.title: Desert safari & BBQ dinner
days.prose: A slow morning, then afternoon pickup for the red dunes of Lahbab. Dune bashing first, then camel rides and sandboarding at the camp, and dinner under string lights with live tanoura. We have requested a family-friendly vehicle with a gentler drive.

days.title: BUrj
days.prose: Up to the 124th floor in the late afternoon so you catch the city in daylight and then watch it switch to night. Afterwards, the Dubai Fountain show runs every thirty minutes, and the Mall's aquarium tunnel is free to walk past.

days.title: Burj kah
days.prose: A full day out: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque in the morning light, then the Louvre Abu Dhabi and a drive along the Corniche. Modest dress is required at the mosque and abayas are available free at the entrance.

days.title: Leisure & shopping
days.prose: Nothing scheduled. Most families use this day for the beach at JBR in the morning and the souks of Old Dubai in the evening — we are happy to arrange either on the day.
